title: Deer wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d="M35 30 Q30 18 22 12" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 22 Q26 20 24 15" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M65 30 Q70 18 78 12" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 22 Q74 20 76 15" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="40" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#d9a066" transform="rotate(-30 24 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="40" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#f0c090" transform="rotate(-30 24 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="40" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#d9a066" transform="rotate(30 76 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="40" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#f0c090" transform="rotate(30 76 40)"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="25" ry="24" fill="#d9a066"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#f0c090"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#5a3a1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="62" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#8a6a4a"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 66 Q46 72 42 70" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 66 Q54 72 58 70" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x="28" y="44" width="18" height="11" rx="4" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <rect x="54" y="44" width="18" height="11" rx="4" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <rect x="46" y="47" width="8" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <rect x="28" y="44" width="18" height="11" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#30305a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="54" y="44" width="18" height="11" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#30305a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <path d="M31 46 L35 46 L31 51 Z" fill="#4a4a8a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M57 46 L61 46 L57 51 Z" fill="#4a4a8a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="60" r="4" fill="#e8a0a0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="60" r="4" fill="#e8a0a0" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
